definitions.explanation: The grammatical form used to ask questions. In Japanese, this typically involves adding か at the end of a sentence or using rising intonation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{疑問形|ぎもんけい}にして⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put this sentence into question form.

examples.japanese: {疑問形|ぎもんけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作|つく}り{方|かた}→作り方：27938_tsukurikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}する→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧。
examples.english: To practice how to form questions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{疑問形|ぎもんけい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文末|ぶんまつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧」⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧だ。
examples.english: The basic way to form questions in Japanese is to add ka at the end of the sentence.

notes:
A grammatical term used in language education and linguistics. Refers to the form of a sentence structured as a question.

JAPANESE QUESTION FORMATION:
- ⟦{丁寧|ていねい}{語|ご}→丁寧語：15824_teineigo⟧: add ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ to the end (e.g., ⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧)
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}{体|たい}→普通体：26128_futsuutai⟧: rising intonation or ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (e.g., ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧？)
- {疑問詞|ぎもんし} (question words): ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧, ⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧, ⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧, ⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧, etc.

RELATED WORDS:
- {疑問文|ぎもんぶん}: interrogative sentence — the sentence itself, not the form
- {疑問詞|ぎもんし}: interrogative word (who, what, where, etc.)
- ⟦{肯定形|こうていけい}→肯定形：22947_kouteikei⟧: affirmative form
- ⟦{否定形|ひていけい}→否定形：11500_hiteikei⟧: negative form

FORMS:
⟦{疑問|ぎもん}→疑問：02648_gimon⟧ (question, doubt) + {形|けい} (form, shape)
